texts: mixed: the rule fires and the storing is covered, but the mire-essence is filed under the role for things an action creates or changes, when storing leaves it exactly as it was — so a question about what is stored can miss it. Nothing in your wording causes this, so no rewrite is needed.
good. the whenever rule fires, the cauldron is a recorded individual, and the essence introduced in the condition is the same essence that then gets kept in clay vessels.

mixed: the drawing is captured, but "the stored mire-essence" is invented afresh for each tending and asserted nowhere, so it never links to the essence your earlier sentences say the Keepers stored, and every tending would draw its own unrelated essence. Introduce it in the trigger so the main clause refers back to it: "Whenever a Keeper tends a lantern and mire-essence is stored in a clay vessel, that Keeper draws that stored mire-essence."
good. "stored" is kept as a condition on the essence, so the rule reaches any particular stored essence and ties it to lantern lighting.
